sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head oval, longer than wide, narrowed towards the mandible bases, sides convex, the frontal gland area paler than the rest of the head and the dorsal outline slightly wavy; fontanelle opening circular, with a horny ring, almost level with the bases of the mandibles; antennae 13—14-segmented, segment 3 the smallest, nearly equal to or longer than segment 2 or 4; labrum nearly triangular, slightly longer than wide, sides nearly parallel, the tip pointed and transparent; mandibles long, sabre-shaped, the tips sharply incurved; postmentum long, broadly bottle-shaped, widest in the anterior third.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow; mandibles dark brown with yellow bases; labrum, antennae, legs and abdomen pale yellow. Head sparsely hairy, pronotum thickly hairy, abdomen densely hairy. Head oval, longer than wide, narrowed towards the mandible bases, sides convex, the frontal gland area paler than the rest of the head, the dorsal outline slightly wavy; fontanelle opening circular, with a horny ring, almost level with the bases of the mandibles; antennae 13—14-segmented, segment 3 the smallest, nearly equal to or longer than segment 2 or 4; labrum nearly triangular, slightly longer than wide, sides nearly parallel, the tip pointed and transparent; mandibles long, sabre-shaped, the tips sharply incurved; postmentum long, broadly bottle-shaped, widest in the anterior third, narrowed anteriorly, with a broad waist posteriorly. Pronotum wider than long, narrower than the head, anterior margin convex with a broad concavity, posterior margin incurved at the middle. Measurements (mm): head length to the lateral base of the mandible 1.13—1.25; maximum head width 0.95—1.08; anterior head width 0.57—0.65; head contraction index 0.59; head index 0.84—0.86; labrum length 0.20—0.28, width 0.20—0.25; mandible length 0.73—0.83; head—mandible index 0.58—0.66; postmentum midlength 0.77—0.80, maximum width 0.35—0.38, waist width 0.18—0.20; pronotum length 0.35—0.40, width 0.65—0.73; pronotum index 0.51—0.59; pronotum/head width index 0.64—0.70; antennae 13—14-segmented.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate unknown. The measurements of this study are given in Table 23 and Table 28; Table 23 does not give the antenna segment number for this species, the 13—14 segments are taken from Table 28.
